messages:
maria: paging eng-runtime, KV cache on hosted-prod is exploding from a small subset of requests; GPUs hitting OOMs in pool-a, dropping requests. seeing large prefix accumulation from customer prompts. incident-bot: Incident created: #1955554321 - kvcache prefix amplification -> OOMs (hosted)
ashok: ack, jumping on it. can someone share the initial host logs? which hosts? samir: host list: gpu-12, gpu-17, gpu-29; errors: OOM, oom_kill process 'inference-runtime'. logs show repeated prefetch for same prefix across thousands of short requests.
lina: initial metric spikes: kvcache_bytes_total on pool-a went from 14GiB -> 68GiB in ~6m. eviction lag metrics spiked to 120s. showing sustained prefetch ops per-second ~11k.
yvonne: Customer impact: ~0.3% p95 request failures, some percent of small gen requests returning 503. CS already has an alert from customers reporting timeouts.
oncall-bot: @maria you are on-call for eng-runtime. Please confirm ownership.
maria: confirmed. plan: 1) reduce prefetch window on hosted runtime to limit prefix prefetching 2) apply temporary per-tenant kvcache cap 3) roll out patch to batcher to avoid amplification by tiny requests 4) monitor and rollback if regressions. samir: noted. what's the prefetch window now? we ship default 4096 tokens.
ashok: set target to 512 for hosted pool-a as emergency. will deploy env override via feature-flag. doing that now: `deploy ff set hosted.pool-a.PREFETCH_MAX_TOKENS=512 --env=prod` lina: patching in progress. pushing hotfix image with `kvcache: limit-prefetch-override` samir: adding per-tenant cap as safeguard: `KVCACHE_MAX_BYTES_PER_TENANT=2GiB` for the next hour. deploying.
ops-bot: rollout started: feature-flag apply -> pool-a nodes (gpu-12,gpu-17,gpu-29) 3/3 started, 0/3 failed. maria: good. start throttling prefetch on these nodes manually too? i want both config + code limit.
yvonne: also enabling automatic fallback to smaller model variants for heavy contexts to reduce cache pressure.
maria: observation after 90s: eviction lag -> 30s, kvcache_bytes_total -> 24GiB. OOMs stopped for gpu-12/gpu-17. still seeing one crash on gpu-29.
ashok: gpu-29 shows repeated long prompt stream from tenant 'acct-73' with single 200k-token prompt causing prefix duplication. killing offending session and temporarily blocking new requests from acct-73. `rbac block acct-73` samir: blocked. adding a short-term rate limit on multi-segment prompts from that tenant.
lina: quick patch to batcher: avoid merging requests whose prefix token count > 1024 into continuous batches. pushed and deployed canary to gpu-29.
maria: canary ok on gpu-29 for 2m, no new OOMs. promoting to rest of pool-a.
incident-bot: Update: mitigation deployed: PREFETCH_MAX_TOKENS override=512, KVCACHE_MAX_BYTES_PER_TENANT=2GiB, batcher merge threshold=1024.
yvonne: CS note: customers A and B saw transient errors; drafting message: "We've mitigated an internal caching issue that affected a small subset of hosted requests; error rates returned to normal after 10 minutes. If you see residual errors, please contact support." samir: add that impacted requests were mostly long/multi-shot prompts exceeding 16k tokens.
maria: post-deploy metrics now: kvcache_bytes_total -> steady at 18GiB, eviction lag 6s, prefetch ops/sec down from 11k to ~900. gpu OOMs reduced to zero in the last 10m.
ashok: next steps: 1) revert per-tenant cap after 2h if stable 2) prepare permanent fix: smarter prefix deduping in prefetcher + throttling heuristics 3) write postmortem and rollout a canary for new prefetcher in staging. lina: i'll own the smart-prefetch change, target PR today and non-rush rollout next week.
maria: please add alerting rule to detect prefix amplification patterns: sudden kvcache_bytes increase correlated with high identical-prefix-hits. samir: adding alert: `kvcache.prefix_amplification > 0.1 for 1m` -> page eng-runtime.
yvonne: CS: will send initial templated customer note; support triaging impacted accounts and offering credits if needed. ops-bot: created internal ticket TICK-7842 to track follow-ups and owner assignments.
maria: handoff to normal on-call in 30m; leaving this thread open until 1h after baseline restored. good job team :thumbsup: everyone add any missing details here for the postmortem.
ashok: note for postmortem: include heap dump from gpu-17 (collected at 1955554373), sample request ids: rq_7b2a..., rq_7b2b..., rate-limited tenant acct-73 logs collected at /var/logs/requests/acct-73-1955554368.log
lina: also include the small patch diff I pushed: `if prefix_tokens > PREFETCH_THRESHOLD: skip_prefetch()` — simple but prevented the amplification.
maria: closing actions: owners assigned: lina (prefetch fix), samir (alerting + batching rule), yvonne (customer comms). will schedule postmortem doc tomorrow. incident-bot: Incident 1955554321 mark: mitigated -> monitoring."
